lynx.help: A and B are the game's two buttons; Option 1 and 2 are its option keys; Pause pauses.

nes.help: A and B are the game's two buttons; Start begins and pauses.

sms.help: Buttons 1 and 2 are the game's two buttons; Start is the console's pause button.

snes.help: A, B, X, Y and the shoulder buttons are the game's own; Start begins and pauses.
